software.label: 开发、调试与质量 / software
software.description: Implement code and prototypes; reproduce bugs, review code, test calculations, improve architecture and performance. 编程、查错、审查、测试。

visual.label: 设计、主题与交互 / design
visual.description: Visual themes, color palettes, typography, accessible interfaces, interactive demos, animation and creative assets. 配色、字体、视觉方案、交互演示。

writing.label: 写作、文档与沟通 / writing
writing.description: Reports, team updates, technical explanations, documentation, tutorials and structured factual communication. 周报、汇报、说明、教学。

data.label: 数据、记录与知识关系 / data
data.description: Databases, structured records, durable memory, knowledge graphs, files, tables, querying and exporting saved information. 保存、查询、关系记录、数据整理。

operations.label: 环境、部署与自动化 / operations
operations.description: Services, infrastructure, deployment, environments, integrations and repeatable operational workflows. 运行环境、部署、服务接入。

security.label: 安全与权限 / security
security.description: Security review, vulnerabilities, audit evidence, permissions, governance and safe handling of sensitive operations. 安全审计、漏洞、权限。

business.label: 产品、计划与经营 / product
business.description: Requirements, planning, product decisions, marketing, business analysis and financial or payment workflows. 需求、产品、推广、经营。

pending.label: 待补分类 / pending
pending.description: Classification is incomplete. Keep these candidates available; no operation is ruled out.
